theorem_statement: For indexed occurrences drawn from k geometric subspace classes, layout cut support states depend only on the first and last occurrence of each class. Deleting middle occurrences preserves layout width, and optimized path-width depends on multiplicities only through min(a_j,2), yielding an exact event-order algorithm parameterized by the number k of distinct geometric classes.
